questions.q: According to Daniel Goleman, ____ component of emotional intelligence focuses on how we handle relationships with others.
questions.explanation: Among the options given, empathy is the only interpersonal component: it is the ability to understand others' feelings, which underlies how we relate to them. Self-awareness, motivation, and emotional regulation are intrapersonal components.
questions.flag: Ambiguous: in Goleman's model, handling relationships is most directly the 'social skills' component; empathy is the closest option offered here.

questions.q: Emotional intelligence can be considered a type of ____ intelligence.
questions.explanation: Salovey and Mayer originally defined emotional intelligence as a subset of social intelligence, involving the ability to monitor one's own and others' emotions. It is not academic (IQ-type) intelligence.

questions.q: Noticing a difficult emotion and slowing down or resisting any impulsive action that may follow highlights ____ component of emotional intelligence.
questions.explanation: Self-regulation is the ability to manage one's emotions and control impulses rather than reacting immediately. Empathy concerns others' feelings, and motivation concerns drive toward goals.

questions.q: The following are signs of emotional intelligence, except ____.
options: ability to manage emotions in difficult situations
questions.explanation: Emotionally intelligent people learn from mistakes and move on rather than dwelling on them. Curiosity, emotional management under stress, and self-confidence are all commonly listed signs of high EI.

options: Understanding only what somebody is saying to you
Understanding both verbal and nonverbal signals
questions.explanation: Perceiving emotions, the first branch of the Mayer-Salovey model, involves accurately reading emotional cues from words as well as body language, tone, and facial expressions. Relying on only one channel misses much of the emotional information.

questions.q: ____ suggests that 10 distinct components provide the scaffolding of emotionally and socially intelligent behaviors:
questions.explanation: Reuven Bar-On's model of emotional-social intelligence identifies 10 key components (such as self-regard, empathy, stress tolerance, and impulse control) plus facilitators. Goleman's model has five components, and Salovey and Mayer describe four branches.

questions.q: Which of the following is a facilitator of EQ?
questions.explanation: In Bar-On's model, optimism, happiness, independence, self-actualization, and social responsibility are treated as facilitators that support emotionally intelligent behavior. Since all three listed qualities are facilitators, 'all of the given' is correct.
questions.flag: PDF key is internally inconsistent: it reads 'Ans. a= all of the given', but option a is 'optimism' and 'all of the given' is option d. The answer text 'all of the given' (index 3) was used.

questions.q: ____ is a strategy for improving one's self-awareness.
questions.explanation: Pursuing one's passion helps people discover what truly matters to them, their strengths, and their values, which builds self-awareness. Rejecting feedback, harsh self-talk, and a fixed mindset all block honest self-reflection.

questions.q: Having students create autobiographies is an example of creating opportunities for ____.
questions.explanation: Writing an autobiography requires students to reflect on their own experiences, feelings, and thought processes, which is a metacognitive activity. Emotional labor and emotional contagion concern managing displayed emotions and catching others' emotions, respectively.

questions.q: Which of the following is not true about management of emotions?
options: It is essentially a private act
It is directly regulated by others
It is influenced by cultural norms
It is influenced by what society defines as appropriate to feel and express
questions.explanation: Emotion management is essentially carried out by the individual, though shaped by cultural and social display rules about what is appropriate to feel and express. It is influenced by others but not directly regulated by them, so that statement is the false one.
